Name: Simon, Brother of Jesus
Summary: Simon was one of the brothers of Jesus named by the people of Nazareth, alongside James, Joses, and Judas. He is distinct from Simon Peter, Simon the Zealot, and every other Simon in the Gospels.
KeyStory: Nazareth named Simon among Jesus' brothers, and took offence at the carpenter's son in their midst.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: Jesus' own town could name His family and still not know Him. Nearness to Jesus is not the same as faith in Him.
